plugins.name: qa-pilot
plugins.description: Evidence-first E2E feature testing: QA-approved test cases, verdicts only from committed Playwright runs against registered deployed environments, a mandatory Playwright trace and deploy SHA per case, a write guard and local-only evidence for production runs, and a case lifecycle in ClickUp or in local files. Portable via a per-project host profile.
